content:
tara: kicking off Elysian POC perf run now. target is 2k embed qps + 300 gen qps sustained. will post quick hits.
ben: thanks. what's the traffic mix and infra?
tara: 85% embeds (seq=64), 15% short-gen (seq=192, max_gen=80). pool: 5x A10g-equivalents (dedicated commit). model: elysian-embed-v1 + elys-gen-small. batching=continuous, batch_timeout_ms=12, max_batch_tokens=5120.
perf-raj: started loadgen. 10m window: sustained qps ~1980, embed p50=19ms p95=130ms p99=415ms. gen p95=340ms p99=1.1s.
ops-bot: autoscaler: pool utilization 94% at 4201234512; reserved commit reached; burst not active.
ben: p99s look high. any correlation with batch_tokens or large generations?
tara: snippet: 
```
[4201234506] id=E221 slot=gpu-2 qlen=6 batch_tks=4800 p95=128ms p99=380ms gpu=87% cache_hit=0.95 nvlink=72%
[4201234509] id=G77 slot=gpu-4 qlen=2 batch_tks=160 p95=26ms p99=90ms gpu=30% cache_hit=0.99 nvlink=10%
[4201234510] id=E300 slot=gpu-1 qlen=13 batch_tks=6200 p95=210ms p99=820ms gpu=99% cache_hit=0.63 nvlink=88%
```
tara: note drop in cache_hit right before big p99.
perf-raj: sounds like KV churn when a large embed batch forms or long-gen touches a worker with cold KV.
infra-mike: reserved pool means autoscaler won't add GPUs. Can enable burst windows for POC if sales ok.
sales-amy: Elysian asked yesterday about burst pricing and if that will "fix" the spikes. Need short answer for contract.
perf-raj: quick answer: burst reduces queueing-related tails by adding capacity, but cold-cache stalls from context churn remain unless we change routing/cache. best to combine both.
ben: propose immediate POC actions: 1) enable prefix cache and increase cache size, 2) create pinned route for gen traffic (1 GPU reserved), 3) reduce batch_timeout_ms to 6ms for lower latency variance, 4) enable a 30min/day burst window.
tara: running reproducer with cache toggle and lower timeout: 
```
./loadgen --target 2000 --burst 2500 --mix "embed:0.85:seq=64,gen:0.15:seq=192" --duration 600 --tag elysian-repro
POST /admin/cache/config {prefix_cache_enabled: true, cache_max_entries: 12000}
POST /admin/batch/config {batch_timeout_ms:6, max_batch_tokens:8192}
```
ops-bot: change_request: enable_burst_autoscale(elysian-poc) submitted by tara at 2026-07-02T09:35:12Z  pending infra-mike approval.
infra-mike: approved. enabling burst for next window.
perf-raj: preliminary repro results with cache+timeout=6: embed p95=98ms p99=220ms, gen p95=260ms p99=680ms. big improvement on median/tail but rare ~700ms spikes remain tied to >256-token gens.
sales-amy: i'll send Elysian a one-paragraph summary: what we tested, recommended config, and ballpark burst cost (~$0.09/min for expected 30min/day). include note on security: embeddings encrypted at rest via KMS; SOC2 evidence available on request.
ben: for contract language suggest: "p95 embed latency <=120ms under committed capacity and recommended routing/batching configs; with configured burst windows, p95 expected to meet target for typical traffic; very long single-request generations may exceed tail and are subject to soft limits or streaming options."
tara: next steps: run 30m validation with burst + pinned gen route, capture token-level traces, then produce single-slide summary for sales. i'll post results here.
perf-raj: if needed i can add per-worker malloc and memcpy tracing during the 30m to confirm NVLink/memcopy hotspots.
ops-bot: validation scheduled at 4201234800.
tara: thanks team. will update after validation. :thumbsup:
